display.label: Onchain idle USDC and net accrued credit accounting

name: Forest Road USDfr
oneLiner: USDfr is Forest Road's credit-backed dollar, minted with USDC and redeemable by KYC-approved holders against available idle reserves.
collateral: Specialty-finance credit receivables and idle canonical USDC in an Ethereum reserve. Forest Road originates and services the book; loan facts enter through threshold-signed attestations. Renewable-energy, media/entertainment and a related-party digital-assets facility are disclosed sectors.
pegMechanism: KYC-approved participants mint USDfr 1:1 with USDC. Direct USDfr-to-USDC redemption pays 1:1 while fully backed and is limited to idle USDC, with transfer blocklisting and pause controls. A separate Uniswap v4 market supports secondary exit. USDfr itself earns no yield; sUSDfr is a separate instrument.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum token 0xcc07e7c4e5e35affd47b351e420a22c667d7f83d is a transferable credit-backed dollar claim. ReserveManager records loan principal/accrual and idle USDC; controller redemption and a verified exact-token secondary market establish ordinary exit. This is credit investment exposure, not core cash backing or the separate yield-bearing sUSDfr wrapper.
